CONFIRMATION MATRIX (docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py) — budget-anchoring CONFIRMED. Same f6fc verification, greedy, same tree, varying the step floor:
- floor 50 (req budget 25): 0/3 runaway, ~100 tool_calls, clean PASS (incl. the earlier diagnostic).
- floor 240 (req budget 120): 2/2 runaway, 145/165 calls, PASS via recovery.
- floor 480 (req budget 240): 3/3 runaway, 131/144/196 calls, PASS via recovery (incl. the f6fc close).
The verifier reaches sufficient evidence around ~100 calls / 25 requests but does not STOP when given more budget — the surplus is spent on redundant re-reading the runaway guard then catches. The flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 hands an 8-criterion ticket ~10x the budget it needs. Lever 1 (criteria-scaled primary floor) is thus grounded: f6fc(8 criteria) converged at ~6 steps/criterion. Proceeding to fold levers 1+2 into 2948's plan (user approved).
